statement: (List.range 32).all (fun hi => (List.range 32).all (fun lo => let m := hi * 32 + lo; let deg : Nat → List Nat := fun x => ([[0,1,2,3],[0,4,5,6],[1,4,7,8],[2,5,7,9],[3,6,8,9]] : List (List Nat)).map (fun l => (l.map (fun i => x / 2 ^ i % 2)).sum); let e : Nat → Nat := fun x => ((List.range 10).map (fun i => x / 2 ^ i % 2)).sum; (e m + e (1023 - m) == 10) && (1023 - (1023 - m) == m) && (List.zipWith (fun a b => a + b) (deg m) (deg (1023 - m))).all (fun s => s == 4))) = true
